evals.name: storage-new-mode
evals.prompt:
Repo root for this run: evals/sets/files/designer/repo (every path below is relative to it).

Section: data/storage
Mode: new
Contract: docs/packages/data/contract.md
Repo contract: docs/architecture.md
Dependency READMEs: packages/data/src/data/ingest/README.md
Upstream interfaces: none
Source probes: none
Change file: none
Design-gap: none
Skills to invoke: none
Write to: docs/packages/data/design/storage.md
Run: run-package data
evals.expected_output: A new design for data/storage at outputs/docs/packages/data/design/storage.md whose first line is `Mode: new`, carrying the eleven template headings with a Module plan and no Revision or As shipped heading, consuming Bar by citing the ingest README, a commit message `data/storage: design` with the run trailer in outputs/commit.txt, and a return of ten lines or fewer beginning `Result: done`.
expectations: outputs/docs/packages/data/design/storage.md exists and its first line is exactly `Mode: new`

The design contains, in this order, headings whose text includes: Purpose and scope; Inputs and outputs; Data model / internal contracts; Workflow / pipeline; Interfaces; Error handling and logging; Tests; Pitfalls and risks; Skills used; Contract deviations; Open questions
The design contains a `Module plan` under the Data model / internal contracts heading, listing files under packages/data/src/data/storage/ and naming which Interfaces rows each file defines
The design contains no heading named `Revision` and no heading named `As shipped`

Under Inputs and outputs, `Bar` (and `load_bars` if consumed) is cited by the path `packages/data/src/data/ingest/README.md` as the document it comes from, and the design does not redefine Bar's fields
The Interfaces table has a Public column; `query_bars` is the only row marked `yes`, and `open_store` and `write_bars` are marked `no`
The design uses the config name `DATA_DB_PATH` from docs/architecture.md Shared conventions and cites D1 for the DuckDB choice rather than restating it as an open question
Every entry under Open questions, if any, is tagged `OQ-data-storage-<k>` and states the assumption designed against; the return's `Open questions:` line lists the same tags or says `none`
outputs/commit.txt exists and contains a first line `data/storage: design` and a trailer line `Dev-Team-Run: run-package data`
transcript.md records reading docs/packages/data/contract.md, docs/architecture.md and packages/data/src/data/ingest/README.md before writing the design
The final message in transcript.md is ten lines or fewer, its first line is exactly `Result: done`, and it contains lines beginning `Design:`, `Open questions:`, `Deviations:` and `Commit:`

No file exists under outputs/ other than docs/packages/data/design/storage.md, commit.txt and, if present, interview.md; in particular outputs/docs/decisions.md does not exist and the return is not `stopped`

evals.name: ingest-delta-from-change-file
evals.prompt:
Repo root for this run: evals/sets/files/designer/repo (every path below is relative to it).

Section: data/ingest
Mode: delta
Contract: docs/packages/data/contract.md
Repo contract: docs/architecture.md
Dependency READMEs: none
Upstream interfaces: none
Source probes: none
Change file: docs/changes/ingest-tz-aware-bars.md
Design-gap: none
Skills to invoke: none
Write to: docs/packages/data/design/ingest.md
Run: run-package data
evals.expected_output: The ingest design rewritten whole at outputs/docs/packages/data/design/ingest.md, first line `Mode: delta` and second line `Change: docs/changes/ingest-tz-aware-bars.md`, with the change file's Contract changes applied (load_bars gains the keyword `tz`, Bar.ts tz-aware UTC, the unknown_tz error code), the unchanged interfaces carried over, no Revision or As shipped heading and no changelog stapled on, a commit `data/ingest: design (delta)`, and a return beginning `Result: done`.
expectations: outputs/docs/packages/data/design/ingest.md exists; its first line is exactly `Mode: delta` and its second line is exactly `Change: docs/changes/ingest-tz-aware-bars.md`

The design contains, in this order, headings whose text includes: Purpose and scope; Inputs and outputs; Data model / internal contracts; Workflow / pipeline; Interfaces; Error handling and logging; Tests; Pitfalls and risks; Skills used; Contract deviations; Open questions
The design contains no heading named `Revision` and no heading named `As shipped`, although the existing design it replaced had both
The Interfaces row for `load_bars` gives the signature from the change file: it contains a keyword-only `tz: str = "America/New_York"` parameter
The design states that every yielded `Bar.ts` is tz-aware UTC, and Error handling and logging names the `IngestError` code `data.ingest.unknown_tz`
The Interfaces table still carries the unchanged rows `discover_files` and `Bar`, so the document is a whole design and not only the delta
The design has no heading or section named Changes, Delta, Changelog or What changed that lists only the differences from the previous design; the change is applied in place under the eleven headings
transcript.md records reading docs/changes/ingest-tz-aware-bars.md and the existing docs/packages/data/design/ingest.md before writing
outputs/commit.txt exists and contains a first line `data/ingest: design (delta)` and a trailer line `Dev-Team-Run: run-package data`
The final message in transcript.md is ten lines or fewer, its first line is exactly `Result: done`, and it contains a `Design:` line naming docs/packages/data/design/ingest.md and a `Commit:` line

No file exists under outputs/ other than docs/packages/data/design/ingest.md, commit.txt and, if present, interview.md; docs/changes/ingest-tz-aware-bars.md and docs/packages/data/contract.md are not written to outputs/

evals.name: prices-spec-change-contract
evals.prompt:
Repo root for this run: evals/sets/files/designer/repo (every path below is relative to it).

Section: data/prices
Mode: new
Contract: docs/packages/data/contract.md
Repo contract: docs/architecture.md
Dependency READMEs: packages/data/src/data/ingest/README.md
Upstream interfaces: none
Source probes: docs/sources/alpaca.md
Change file: none
Design-gap: none
Skills to invoke: none
Write to: docs/packages/data/design/prices.md
Run: run-package data
evals.expected_output: No design is written; instead outputs/docs/deviations.md gains one appended `## data/prices — <date> — spec-change:contract` entry whose Clause cites the contract's prices interface row, whose Found cites the probe doc's Observed schema (no adjusted_close field; adjustment is a request parameter and `c` is the adjusted close), with Status open and Raised by the designer; outputs/commit.txt commits the ledger with scope data/prices and the run trailer; the return is `Result: spec-change`, then `Spec-change: contract — <one line>`, then the entry heading, ten lines or fewer.
expectations: outputs/docs/packages/data/design/prices.md does not exist
outputs/docs/deviations.md exists, keeps the fixture's title line and note, and appends exactly one entry whose heading matches `## data/prices — <YYYY-MM-DD> — spec-change:contract`
The entry has lines beginning `Clause:`, `Said:`, `Found:`, `Why:`, `Status:` and `Raised by:`; `Status:` is `open`

`Clause:` names the package contract's Section interfaces entry for prices (`fetch_bars`, the `adjusted_close` claim), and `Said:` quotes or paraphrases that the response carries an `adjusted_close` field

`Found:` cites docs/sources/alpaca.md (its Observed schema or Quirks heading) and states that no `adjusted_close` field exists and that adjustment is the `adjustment` request parameter with `c` as the adjusted close
`Raised by:` names the designer and the run (`run-package data`), and no `Resolved by:` line claims a resolution

transcript.md records reading docs/sources/alpaca.md and docs/packages/data/contract.md, and reading the deviations entry template under skills/planning-templates/references/ (deviations-entry.md) before writing the entry

The final message in transcript.md is ten lines or fewer; its first line is exactly `Result: spec-change`, its second line begins `Spec-change: contract — `, and its third line is the entry heading written to outputs/docs/deviations.md
outputs/commit.txt exists, its first line begins `data/prices: ` and it has a trailer line `Dev-Team-Run: run-package data`; the commit stages docs/deviations.md and no design file
No file exists under outputs/ other than docs/deviations.md, commit.txt and, if present, interview.md; in particular outputs/docs/decisions.md does not exist and the return is not `stopped` or `done`
The transcript does not describe the contradiction as an Open questions entry, a Contract deviations entry or a Pitfalls and risks entry of a design; it is raised only as the ledger entry
